rejected_rule.statement: The Appellant cannot contest the opinion of the Competent Authority in ejectment proceedings under the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Under Section 9 of the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act, as amended in 1983, the Competent Authority’s opinion that land is a “State land” is conclusive and not open to judicial challenge at the ejectment stage, and the only permissible defence available to an occupier is to prove possession or occupation under a valid permit or written authority issued by the State, with the burden of proof resting on the occupier, whose failure to establish such authority would necessitates an order of ejectment.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 9 of the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act, as amended in 1983
